title: Vallee urges Hynek to review Blue Book's 'psychological' cases
place_text: Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Dayton, Ohio

tellings.quote: jacqu valet had just met with Dr at rright patteron Air Force Base in Dayton Ohio in 1964

plain: In 1964 the UFO researcher Jacques Vallée met the astronomer J. Allen Hynek at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Dayton, Ohio. Vallée is said to have urged Hynek to look again at the cases that Blue Book, the US Air Force's UFO study of the 1950s and 60s, had written off as "psychological." The documentary filmmaker James Fox tells Michels the story as he learned it from these men and from the Blue Book records.
